authority_result_interpretation: Clean, FindingsPresent and Unanalyzable are analyzer classifications, not test pass/fail counts. Negative inputs intentionally exercise refusals. Each input was analyzed twice and reports compared for equality.

full_library_attempt.result: Stopped under shared-memory pressure while compiling frankenengine-core; no test binary and no source/test verdict. Subsequent disk exhaustion also prevented full qualification.

filesystem.known_difference: Node coerces a forged path object once in its fd-overload probe; engine test explicitly requires zero guest coercions at the supported-path boundary.

node_reference_checks.limitation: Node checks do not validate FrankenEngine execution, capabilities, GC, or host-effect transcripts.

remaining_blockers: Direct and namespace fs/promises reads are Clean on v0.2.0 but FE-CAP-0001 FindingsPresent on starting main and patched source.

First-class Events reports can be Clean with an empty footprint although module initialization requires Builtin. IR2 aggregation misses nested factory hostcalls; final IR3 aggregation includes them but also unused-method Timer authority. Initialization/selected-method summaries remain needed.

The retained exact-two-argument EventsOnce intrinsic bypasses public listener registration and async promise adoption. Native conformance for newListener, overridden once, delivery order and invalid targets remains unverified.
Full first-class filesystem authority and runtime construction requirements remain unqualified. Bare-import refusals in this matrix also occur at v0.2.0 and are not newly measured regressions.
Native interpreter argument validation, real host effects, capability-denial fixtures, orchestration, and the complete library/integration comparison have not run successfully in this environment.
All-target check, clippy and full format attempts were resource-aborted; no canonical gate pass is claimed.
historical_counts: The October8 issue counts and October14 baseline are historical; this snapshot does not remeasure their complete test population.
